methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this study, the concept and development process of the international standard for energy management assessment is discussed.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper documents the development of ISO TS 50011, a qualitative maturity/progress assessment standard for energy management systems (checklist scoring across organisation structure, operation, and target achievement). It presents no EnPI/EnB measurement model; energy intensity appears only as Japanese regulatory background.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the score of each structure out of 100 points and the final score is the sum of each score in the structure

stage1.notes: Borderline: p.2 notes energy intensity (energy per product/selling unit) and its denominator sensitivity, a possible EnPI critique, but this is incidental regulatory background. Core deliverable is a maturity/progress assessment method (ISO TS 50011), not an EnPI/EnB model. Ruled ineligible per the maturity-assessment-without-model-content clause.
